description: The document header of TmDocumentEditor (redesign DE-1.1): a document icon, a HeaderStart host slot, the title (and an optional subtitle), a version / template preview chip, the save state (Saving... / Unsaved changes / Last saved HH:mm:ss, one dot colour per state) and, on the right, the document actions: Search (opens the editor's find panel), Undo, Redo, Print preview, Print to PDF (rendered only when an export provider exists - G9: a built-in action exists only with the capability behind it) and the primary Save, followed by the HeaderActions host slot (Share and similar - the editor offers no Share of its own). Undo / Redo / Save keep the test ids document-undo / document-redo / document-save and the data-command values they had in the ribbon quick-access group, and render exactly once: here, or in the ribbon when TmDocumentEditor.ShowHeader is false. The header is its own inline-size container (tm-doc-editor-header): below 1024 px it drops the subtitle and the button labels (the accessible names stay), below 640 px it also drops the icon and the status text. It sits outside the editor's main size container because host slots may open fixed overlays.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Document title shown in the header (the editor passes its Title parameter or the document metadata title).

parameters.name: Subtitle
parameters.description: Optional second line next to the title. Hidden when empty.

parameters.name: ModeLabel
parameters.description: Optional mode chip (version preview, template preview). Hidden when empty.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Whether the editor is read-only; Save, Undo and Redo are disabled.

parameters.name: IsSaving
parameters.description: Whether a save is in flight.

parameters.name: IsDirty
parameters.description: Whether the document has unsaved changes.

parameters.name: LastSavedAt
parameters.description: Timestamp of the latest successful save.

parameters.name: CanUndo
parameters.description: Whether the undo stack has an entry.

parameters.name: CanRedo
parameters.description: Whether the redo stack has an entry.

parameters.name: NextUndoDescription
parameters.description: Description of the next undo step, shown in the tooltip.

parameters.name: NextRedoDescription
parameters.description: Description of the next redo step, shown in the tooltip.

parameters.name: CommandRegistry
parameters.description: The editor command registry; its state wins over the plain flags exactly like in the ribbon.

parameters.name: ShowPrintPreview
parameters.description: Whether the Print preview action is offered.

parameters.name: PrintPreviewActive
parameters.description: Whether the print preview is currently active.

parameters.name: CanExportPdf
parameters.description: Whether Print to PDF is available (an export provider exists and the user may export). The button is not rendered otherwise.

parameters.name: IsExportingPdf
parameters.description: Whether a PDF export is in flight.

parameters.name: HeaderStart
parameters.description: Host content before the title block (a back link, a logo).

parameters.name: HeaderActions
parameters.description: Host actions after the built-in ones (Share).

parameters.name: OnSearch
parameters.description: Raised by the Search button; the editor opens its find panel.

parameters.name: OnUndo
parameters.description: Raised by the Undo button.

parameters.name: OnRedo
parameters.description: Raised by the Redo button.

parameters.name: OnSave
parameters.description: Raised by the Save button.

parameters.name: OnOpenPrintPreview
parameters.description: Raised by the Print preview button.

parameters.name: OnExportPdf
parameters.description: Raised by the Print to PDF button.

parameters.name: Compact
parameters.description: The phone header (decision G2): the title, the save state as an icon, Search, Undo, Redo and a kebab. Save, Print preview and the export move to the action bar and the kebab; the host's HeaderActions render inside the kebab panel. Defaults to false (the full header).

examples.title: Host slots through TmDocumentEditor
examples.code:
<TmDocumentEditor DocumentId="@id" Provider="@provider"
                  Title="Project Aurora" Subtitle="Draft proposal"
                  PdfExportProvider="@pdf">
    <!-- RenderFragment parameters are passed as attributes -->
</TmDocumentEditor>
